title: Finding Errors Is Not Enough: Selective Model Escalation for Entity-Targeted Sentiment Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.02989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Improving a sentiment classifier with limited resources involves more than simply deciding how much data to collect or which model to train. A labelled collection may lack examples of an important class. Once trained, a classifier may benefit from another model even when that model is weaker on its own. We study these decisions in document-level Entity-Level Sentiment Analysis (ELSA), primarily using South Slavic news. We first compare acquisition orders as collections grow. We then use uncertainty to choose which predictions to revisit, how many to process, and whether an alternative encoder or local LLM can correct them. Finally, we select complete routing policies on development data for held-out evaluation. Minority-prioritised acquisition helps at some very small training sizes, but not consistently thereafter. On SentiCoref, an oracle correcting all errors in the least-confident 10% without harming correct predictions would add 9.1

translated_title: 仅仅发现错误还不够：面向实体目标情感分析的选择性模型升级
translated_abstract: 在资源有限的情况下改进情感分类器，不仅仅是决定收集多少数据或训练哪个模型这么简单。已标注的数据集可能缺少某个重要类别的样本；而训练完成后，即使另一个模型本身较弱，分类器也可能从中受益。我们在文档级实体级情感分析中研究这些决策，主要使用南斯拉夫语系新闻数据。我们首先比较了数据集增长过程中的采集顺序；然后利用不确定性来选择需要重新审视哪些预测、处理多少个，以及替代编码器或本地大语言模型能否纠正它们；最后，我们在开发数据上选择完整的路由策略，并在留出数据上进行评估。结果表明，优先采集少数类样本仅在极小的训练规模下有帮助，但此后效果并不持续。在SentiCoref数据集上，一个能够纠正最低置信度10%预测中所有错误且不损害正确预测的预言机，可带来9.1（摘要在此处截断）的提升。
tldr: 该论文研究了实体级情感分析中基于不确定性的选择性模型升级策略，发现优先采集少数类样本仅在极小训练规模下有效，而将低置信度预测交由替代编码器或本地大语言模型处理可纠正错误并提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper studies uncertainty-based selective model escalation for entity-level sentiment analysis, showing that minority-prioritized data acquisition only helps at very small training sizes, and that routing low-confidence predictions to alternative encoders or local LLMs can effectively correct errors and improve performance.
